findings.claim: The manual EcoCrew trial acceptance criterion has no write or gate in the plan.
findings.closure: Closure: the plan maps the EcoCrew criterion to a named post-install manual gate listing its observable checks (two forks with no versioned kit, one orchestrate session reaching the PR, close bringing docs/work/<slug>/ back) and where the result is recorded.

findings.claim: No case makes a close copy-back fail and asserts the worktree survives (verification before removal).
findings.closure: Closure: a named close case where the main-tree destination cannot be written; close exits non-zero, the worktree stays registered and on disk with docs/work/<slug>/ intact, branch untouched.

findings.claim: Story-file derivation only tested with a hyphen-free feature; agent-ia-3.7 needs a last-hyphen split.
KT7 does not assert every excluded path (kit-backup/, .loop-record.lock, .codex-ready, .quota-warning, .hook-timings.log, .eslint-queue*, *.key, credentials.*, codex-last-message.txt, pr-body.md).
G22.118/G22.119 already exist; the harness fails duplicate ids.
findings.closure: Closure: the plan names free ids (G22.120, G22.121) for the two rows and step 3 references them.

findings.claim: Kit-local closing order leaves loop-record --clear and handoff phase: shipped unplaced relative to close, and tracks.md step 0 / ship.md 4bis keep the old order.
findings.closure: Closure: one kit-local closing order (record clear + handoff phase: shipped in the worktree, then close, then step 5 in the main tree, then git branch -d) written into orchestrate.md Phase 0 step 0, tracks.md step 0 and ship.md 4bis/4bis-local, each asserted by a contract case.

findings.claim: Contract excludes paths cwk_is_guarded would deny reading, but cwk_is_guarded is a write-guard list covering kit files that must be copied.
KT4 asserts only a deny; protect-files fails closed, so a broken copy also denies; resolution via $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR not exercised.
KT8 fixture must ignore .claude/ while force-tracking .claude/hooks, else the ls-tree half is untested.
ship.md item-3 line must say close runs from a main-tree session; --merged passed by orchestrate after closable relies on close staying a prompted call.
Nothing pins that orchestrate Phase 0.5 hands a kit-local track to ./workflow.sh instead of EnterWorktree.
Copy-back states without rule: new file absent from manifest but present in main, new files in snapshot folders, owned destinations tracked in main.
Script in .claude/scripts: CI ruff lints only .claude/hooks; no shell-guard row for the fork call; KT2 fixture must create INSTALL_PROFILE, kit-manifest and the overlay.
